proposed_exceptions.reason: Sub-pixel glyph coverage and the existing #105 Helvetica-metadata/Liberation Sans substitution. Under the user-approved spec §8.5 per-glyph device-phase rule, these axis-aligned glyphs retain the whole-device-Y baseline and use quarter-device-pixel X origins; this replaces the former whole-line-only baseline placement. SVG path geometry, scene extent and document parity remain correct. The residual is interior label-glyph coverage between the rasterizers, including the pinned reference system Liberation Sans light autohinting/x-height behavior. The new exact limits are independently remeasured; they do not attribute the residual to obsolete whole-line placement.

Existing #121 monochrome emoji compatibility substitution: bundled Noto Emoji 3.003 replaces the reference Noto Color Emoji 2.047. Their glyph shapes and advances differ and move following text. Under the user-approved spec §8.5 per-glyph device-phase rule, these axis-aligned glyphs retain the whole-device-Y baseline and use quarter-device-pixel X origins; this replaces the former whole-line-only baseline placement. The temporary placement-only control reproduces the former measurement exactly, and current native output reproduces the new measurement. The fallback/advance difference remains the non-defect cause; per-glyph ranges and fallback-run partitions are intact.

Existing #152/#124/#125 deterministic missing-glyph compatibility substitution: unsupported Hebrew/Arabic and paragraph-separator scalars use the basic-Latin question mark from Liberation Sans instead of the reference fallback glyphs. Different advances displace adjacent text; bidi run order and paragraph behavior remain as specified. Under the user-approved spec §8.5 per-glyph device-phase rule, these axis-aligned glyphs retain the whole-device-Y baseline and use quarter-device-pixel X origins; this replaces the former whole-line-only baseline placement. A placement-only temporary control reproduces old/new measurements with unchanged SVG output and verified glyph/fallback/bidi outline partitions.

Existing #152/#124/#125 deterministic basic-Latin question-mark fallback and its different advances for unsupported RTL scalars. Physical line anchoring and bidi order remain as specified. Under the user-approved spec §8.5 per-glyph device-phase rule, these axis-aligned glyphs retain the whole-device-Y baseline and use quarter-device-pixel X origins; this replaces the former whole-line-only baseline placement. The separate #168 SVG harness direction/paragraph limitation and its measured SVG pin remain unchanged. The direct-PNG limits are remeasured only for the approved per-glyph placement, with unchanged SVG output and verified outline/run partitions.
